env.notes: Optional secrets/endpoints for custom commands. Read from the environment when left blank (INSTABOT_TOKEN / INSTABOT_URL). Use them for a custom music server or any external API your commands call.

server.notes: Default mode "instachat" uses the built-in lib/instachat-api (cookies only: IG_COOKIES env or account.txt). The old hosted ICA server is dead. "direct" needs the private @lazyneoaz/ig-chat-api package; "server" needs url+token of your own ig-chat-api-server. IG_MODE overrides this.

account.notes: Instagram login is cookie-only. Put your Instagram cookies in account.txt: a Netscape cookie file (Cookie-Editor export), a `sessionid=...; ds_user_id=...; csrftoken=...` string, or a JSON array of cookie objects. `sessionid` and `ds_user_id` are required. `proxy` is an optional HTTP(S) proxy URL and `userAgent` overrides the default Instagram Android user agent.

music.notes: Song search for the sing command. Leave apiUrl/apiToken blank to search Instagram's own music catalogue. Point them at your music server to search there instead; {query} is replaced with the song text.

welcome.selfMessage: Thanks for inviting me to %2 💋. Type {prefix}help to see all available commands.
welcome.notes: Greet members added to a group thread. %1 = the new member, %2 = the thread name. selfMessage is sent when the BOT itself is added ({prefix} = the live prefix, %2 = the group name). Leave threadIDs empty for every thread, or list the thread IDs to limit it. card: picture sent with the text ("welcard" or "welcome" = toshiro canvas API, false = text only). fallbackScan: also greet members found by watching the member list when Instagram sends no join event.

leave.notes: Announce members who leave or are removed from a group thread. %1 = the member, %2 = the thread name. Leave threadIDs empty for every thread.

onlineStatus.notes: Appends one JSON line per interval recording that the bot is online, together with uptime and basic stats.

github.notes: Saves users/threads to a GitHub repo so data survives redeploys. Prefer env vars GITHUB_TOKEN and GITHUB_REPO (owner/repo) over writing the token here. Use a PRIVATE repo.

database.notes: Simple JSON storage for users and threads. Files are created automatically. With database.github set they are also mirrored to GitHub.

optionsFca.notes: Extra options passed to ig-chat-api.login() in direct mode (same values as Insta-Bot3). minRequestInterval (ms) spaces API calls.
